title: Make security history artifact version allocation atomic
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that SecurityServices derives artifact version numbers from existing.Count + 1 before writing the artifact and metadata. Concurrent requests can select the same version, overwrite a path, fail uniqueness, or leave orphaned files. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/Services/SecurityServices.cs lines 1043-1080. Allocate versions transactionally and reconcile artifact writes on metadata failure.
